prompt: If Jessica (to have) a bigger shop, she would keep more fish.
explanation_ru: Ситуация воображаемая: сейчас магазин не больше. В условии второго типа — Past Simple (had), в результате — would + инфинитив.

prompt: If the oven (to work) well, the cakes would not burn.
explanation_ru: Это жалоба: духовка сейчас греет неровно. Нереальное условие ставим в Past Simple (worked).

prompt: If Marcus (to open) his own van, he would be his own boss.
explanation_ru: Маркус только мечтает о фургоне. В условии второго типа — Past Simple (opened), в результате — would.

prompt: If I (to be) you, I would take the smaller van.
explanation_ru: В «If I were you» всегда пишем were — это совет, а не прошедшее время.

prompt: Would Daria (to sleep) better if she left her phone in the kitchen?
explanation_ru: После would в вопросе второго типа идёт инфинитив без частицы to (sleep).

prompt: The flight would not feel so long if Viktor (to sit) beside his children.
explanation_ru: Главная часть (would not feel) показывает второй тип, поэтому в условии ставим Past Simple (sat).

prompt: If this fitting room light (to work), Daniel could see the true colour.
explanation_ru: Свет сейчас сломан, поэтому условие нереально: Past Simple (worked), а could + инфинитив — о возможности.

prompt: If Beatriz (to swim) the final as calmly as she does in training, she would finally reach the podium.
explanation_ru: Условие воображаемое: сейчас она не в финале, поэтому Past Simple (swam) без значения прошедшего; в главной части would + инфинитив.

prompt: Rahim is nervous about his toast. His friend says: 'If I (to be) you, I (to keep) it short.' Rahim thinks a short speech would be easier.
explanation_ru: Совет через второй тип: в «If I were you» стоит were, а в главной части — would + инфинитив (would keep).

prompt: Meera lives far from Chennai and sees her old friends once a year. If she (to live) closer, she (to see) them much more often. The city would feel like home again.
explanation_ru: Сейчас она живёт далеко, поэтому условие нереально: Past Simple (lived) без значения прошедшего; результат would see.

prompt: Karim complains that the library Wi-Fi is slow. The librarian says: 'If you (to sit) near the router, the pages (to load) much faster.' Karim moves to a table by the wall.
explanation_ru: Совет о ситуации, которой ещё нет: Past Simple (sat) в условии, would + инфинитив (would load) в результате.

prompt: Leo says: 'If the kitten were older, it ___ outside safely.'
options: will go
would go
would went
goes
explanation_ru: В главной части второго типа после would идёт инфинитив без частицы to (would go); «would went» — ошибка: после would нельзя ставить прошедшую форму.

prompt: Natalia asks: 'Would you mind if I ___ this bag while I look at the other colours?'
options: hold
holds
will hold
held
explanation_ru: После «Would you mind if I…» глагол стоит в Past Simple (held) — это вежливая просьба, а не прошедшее время.

prompt: Piotr imagines a calm office. 'If every meeting ___ by email,' he thinks, 'the day would be much quieter.'
options: would happen
will happen
happened
happens
explanation_ru: После if во втором типе — Past Simple (happened), а не would/will: «would happen» — типичная ошибка из-за русского «если бы».

prompt: Vanja watches a falling ball and wonders: 'What ___ happen if gravity suddenly disappeared?'
options: would
will
did
does
explanation_ru: Вопрос о воображаемой ситуации (если бы гравитация исчезла) — второй тип: What would happen + if + Past Simple.

prompt: Sanaa chose the pharmacy over a clinic job years ago, and she still regrets it. 'If I ___ again,' she thinks, 'I would choose the small clinic and the mothers I dreamed of.'
options: would have the choice
will have the choice
had the choice
have the choice
explanation_ru: После if во втором типе — Past Simple (had), а не would/will: «если бы у меня был выбор». В главной части would + инфинитив.

prompt: The smaller print would fit your frame if you chose it.
answer: The smaller print would fit your frame if you chose it.
accepted_answers: The smaller print would fit your frame if you chose it.
explanation_ru: Предложение уже верное: if + Past Simple (chose) в условии, would + инфинитив (would fit) в главной части. Ошибки нет.

prompt: Femke would ride home dry if the rain would stop by five.
answer: Femke would ride home dry if the rain stopped by five.
accepted_answers: Femke would ride home dry if the rain stopped by five.
explanation_ru: После if нельзя ставить would: здесь нужно Past Simple (stopped). Would остаётся в главной части.

prompt: If Aleksandr would have a quiet flat, he would not feel so tired in class.
answer: If Aleksandr had a quiet flat, he would not feel so tired in class.
accepted_answers: If Aleksandr had a quiet flat, he would not feel so tired in class.
If Aleksandr had a quiet flat, he wouldn't feel so tired in class.
explanation_ru: После if нужен Past Simple (had), а не would have: «would have» в условии — типичная ошибка из-за русского «если бы».

prompt: I would enjoy the show more if the staff move me to a better seat.
answer: I would enjoy the show more if the staff moved me to a better seat.
accepted_answers: I would enjoy the show more if the staff moved me to a better seat.
explanation_ru: В условии второго типа нужен Past Simple (moved), а не настоящее время (move): главная часть (would enjoy) уже показывает нереальность.

prompt: Jiyeon's cousin wants to sign the contract for a new flat after one quick visit. Jiyeon thinks that is risky and offers her advice.
options: If I am you, I would visit the flat at different times.
If I were you, I would visit the flat at different times.
If I would be you, I would visit the flat at different times.
If I were you, I will visit the flat at different times.
explanation_ru: Совет через второй тип: «If I were you» + would + инфинитив. Варианты с am, will и would be в условии ошибочны.

prompt: Rafael's bus is late again, and it is raining hard. He is tired of waiting and thinks about the bus company.
options: If the buses ran on time, Rafael would not wait in the rain.
If the buses run on time, Rafael will not wait in the rain.
If the buses would run on time, Rafael would not wait in the rain.
If the buses ran on time, Rafael will not wait in the rain.
explanation_ru: Это жалоба на нереальную сейчас ситуацию, поэтому второй тип: if + Past Simple (ran), would + инфинитив (would not wait).

prompt: Angus does not have the museum job, so he is not proud. → If Angus had the museum job,
answer: If Angus had the museum job, he would be proud.
accepted_answers: If Angus had the museum job, he would be proud.
explanation_ru: Сейчас поста нет, поэтому условие второго типа: if + Past Simple (had), в главной части would be (would be proud).

prompt: If each form filled itself in, I would finish the pile quickly.
options: The forms fill themselves in, so I finish quickly.
The forms do not fill themselves in, so I work slowly.
The forms did not fill themselves in, so I worked slowly.
I finish quickly because the forms fill themselves in.
explanation_ru: Настоящая ситуация противоположна условию: формы сами не заполняются, поэтому работа идёт медленно (время сохраняется — настоящее).

prompt: The soil would stay in place if the hillside were covered in young trees.
options: The hillside is covered in trees, so the soil stays in place.
The hillside was not covered in trees, so the soil washed away.
The hillside is not covered in trees, so the soil washes away.
The trees cover the hillside, so the soil stays in place.
explanation_ru: На самом деле склон не покрыт деревьями, поэтому почва вымывается: это настоящее время, полярность противоположна условию.

prompt: The young fan would feel at home if she were directing her own quiet drama by the sea.
options: She is not directing any film, so she does not feel at home.
She is directing a film by the sea, so she feels at home.
She was not directing any film, so she did not feel at home.
She feels at home because she is directing the drama.
explanation_ru: Настоящая ситуация противоположна: она не снимает фильм, поэтому не чувствует себя как дома; время остаётся настоящим.

prompt: Match the halves to make correct sentences.
pairs: she would run one more practice.
explanation_ru: Второй тип: if + Past Simple в условии, would + инфинитив в главной части. Соединяй половинки по подлежащему и смыслу.

prompt: Join each half with its correct ending.
pairs: I would book the slower night boat.
If Kwame had a life jacket,
explanation_ru: Второй тип: if + Past Simple (were/had/sailed), would + инфинитив в результате. Подбирай половинки по подлежащему и смыслу.

prompt: Build the sentence.
answer: If Petra were to book early, the workshop would still have places.
accepted_answers: If Petra were to book early, the workshop would still have places.
explanation_ru: «If Petra were to book» — формальный способ выразить маловероятное условие; далее в главной части would + инфинитив.

prompt: Which group does each sentence belong to?

items.text: If I find my sheet music, I will sing.
If the conductor has a spare copy, he will lend it to me.
If we print new copies, everyone will be ready.
If I had my sheet music, I would sing.
If the conductor were here, he would help me.
If I knew the song, I would not worry.

explanation_ru: Первый тип (настоящее время в if + will) — о реальном и возможном; второй тип (Past Simple + would) — о воображаемом и нереальном.
